con:soapui-project.name: ElderCare Connect - Legacy EMR Integration
con:soapui-project.con:description: SoapUI tests for the Legacy Clinic EMR SOAP contract (GetPatientHistory) and the ElderCare SOAP/XML -> JSON adapter. Start the stack (docker compose up) or run services/mock-legacy-emr and services/legacy-emr-adapter locally. Adjust project properties for other hosts.

con:part.con:content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <!-- Legacy RHU Clinic EMR - SOAP 1.1 contract for GetPatientHistory. Used by the mock server, the ElderCare Legacy EMR Adapter, and the SoapUI test project. --> <wsdl:definitions name="LegacyClinicEmr" targetNamespace="http://rhu.health.gov.ph/emr/v1" xmlns:tns="http://rhu.health.gov.ph/emr/v1" xmlns:wsdl="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/" xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/soap/" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
<wsdl:types> <xsd:schema targetNamespace="http://rhu.health.gov.ph/emr/v1" elementFormDefault="qualified"> <xsd:element name="GetPatientHistoryRequest"> <xsd:complexType> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="PatientId" type="xsd:string"/> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> </xsd:element>
<xsd:complexType name="Diagnosis"> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="IcdCode" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="Description" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="DiagnosedOn" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="Chronic" type="xsd:boolean"/> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType>
<xsd:complexType name="Visit"> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="VisitId" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="VisitDate" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="VisitType" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="Facility" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="ChiefComplaint" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0"/> <xsd:element name="BloodPressure" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0"/> <xsd:element name="Remarks" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0"/> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType>
<xsd:complexType name="Medication"> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="DrugName" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="Dosage" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="Frequency" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="Active" type="xsd:boolean"/> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType>
<xsd:element name="GetPatientHistoryResponse"> <xsd:complexType> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="PatientHistory"> <xsd:complexType> <xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="PatientId" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="FacilityCode" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="FullName" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="BirthDate" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="Sex" type="xsd:string"/> <xsd:element name="Diagnoses"><xsd:complexType><xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="Diagnosis" type="tns:Diagnosis" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/> </xsd:sequence></xsd:complexType></xsd:element> <xsd:element name="Visits"><xsd:complexType><xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="Visit" type="tns:Visit" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/> </xsd:sequence></xsd:complexType></xsd:element> <xsd:element name="Medications"><xsd:complexType><xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="Medication" type="tns:Medication" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/> </xsd:sequence></xsd:complexType></xsd:element> <xsd:element name="Allergies"><xsd:complexType><xsd:sequence> <xsd:element name="Allergy" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/> </xsd:sequence></xsd:complexType></xsd:element> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> </xsd:element> </xsd:sequence> </xsd:complexType> </xsd:element> </xsd:schema> </wsdl:types>
<wsdl:message name="GetPatientHistoryInput"> <wsdl:part name="parameters" element="tns:GetPatientHistoryRequest"/> </wsdl:message> <wsdl:message name="GetPatientHistoryOutput"> <wsdl:part name="parameters" element="tns:GetPatientHistoryResponse"/> </wsdl:message>
<wsdl:portType name="LegacyClinicEmrPortType"> <wsdl:operation name="GetPatientHistory"> <wsdl:input message="tns:GetPatientHistoryInput"/> <wsdl:output message="tns:GetPatientHistoryOutput"/> </wsdl:operation> </wsdl:portType>
<wsdl:binding name="LegacyClinicEmrSoapBinding" type="tns:LegacyClinicEmrPortType"> <soap:binding style="document" transport="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/http"/> <wsdl:operation name="GetPatientHistory"> <soap:operation soapAction="http://rhu.health.gov.ph/emr/v1/GetPatientHistory"/> <wsdl:input><soap:body use="literal"/></wsdl:input> <wsdl:output><soap:body use="literal"/></wsdl:output> </wsdl:operation> </wsdl:binding>
<wsdl:service name="LegacyClinicEmrService"> <wsdl:port name="LegacyClinicEmrPort" binding="tns:LegacyClinicEmrSoapBinding"> <soap:address location="http://localhost:4005/emr"/> </wsdl:port> </wsdl:service> </wsdl:definitions>

con:testCase.name: TC1 - GetPatientHistory (known patient)
con:testCase.con:description: Live call against the legacy EMR (or the bundled mock) - verifies WSDL contract compliance.

con:testCase.name: TC2 - Unknown patient returns SOAP Fault
con:testCase.con:description: Negative test: the adapter maps this fault to HTTP 404.

con:testCase.name: TC3 - Adapter translates SOAP/XML to internal JSON
con:testCase.con:description: Protocol mediation: SOAP response in, JSON contract out (Section 10 / 15).
